The 2026-11-02 run of this case was all SKIP because its gate also demanded a refused page below the block; the gate now checks only the end, the one boundary a cell can cross. The sixteen Tier B cells (invalid-tail-b1..b4, delta 1, 4, 0x1000 and 0x2000) are cited from the 2026-11-06 PSP-3000 runs (system software 6.61, ARK-5.1.0 (owner); pspver 6.6.0; boots 139 (memcpy-dst), 140 (memcpy-src), 141 (try-dst) and 142 (try-src), XMB context) of commit 8db3ec9d, the cases dma-invalid-tail-memcpy-dst, -memcpy-src, -try-dst and -try-src, each after the transport-write preflight: 4 records and the done record per case, all PASS, acceptance-eligible with 0 blockers, setup_mask 0x7. Every Tier B request lies inside memory the probe owns; what the PSP does for a span that crosses an unmapped edge is still unmeasured (#303 Tier E, owner review).

tests.evidence_note: Built as case 181, a fixed-shape stream of 44 records and the done record. Captured by the 2026-11-10 (UTC) PSP-3000 launch of commit 80e7c9eb, case ge-signal, on boot 179 in the XMB context; 80e7c9eb is a pre-publication commit whose ge-signal section in probe.c and Makefile CASE line are identical to this tree's. Firmware: system software 6.61 (flash0:/vsh/etc/version.txt: release:6.61:, system:58401@release_661,0x06060110:); PSPLink pspver 0x06060010, which the runner records as 6.6.0 and which pspver prints in the XMB context on this boot (0x06060110 in the game context); custom firmware ARK-5 with cIPL, version 5.1.0 (operator-declared, not read by a tool). 37 records (the setup record and the three records of 12 of the 14 cells, ctl through rcall-al), 35 PASS and 2 TIMEOUT (gsg-b00-end, gsg-b04-end). Not acceptance-eligible: the stream is incomplete. Its last line is the step marker rjump-un (RJUMP, unaligned offset 0x22); no record of that cell, of rcall-un, of the teardown or the done record followed, the 300 s case timeout expired, the loaded module was not proven unloaded, the host0 round trip failed, and the console no longer answered over USB and needed a manual power cycle. POWER RISK: rjump-un and rcall-un are not to be re-run unattended. The capture establishes nothing about PSP behaviour, and a rerun of this revision cannot be acceptance-eligible (cells b00 and b04 end TIMEOUT, and rjump-un stalled the console in this capture); what it shows (handler words sampled in the GE interrupt; post-run 0x55-0x57 reads of 0x55ffffff, 0x56ffffff and 0x57ffffff are the VSH's, not the probe's): sceGeSetCallback gave id 1 to the handlers and id 2 to an all-NULL structure; compiled SDK version 0x06060110. 0x01: the signal handler ran once (id 0x1234, arg 0x5161, list state 2) with marker A still in 0x55 on entry and return, and the finish handler (id 0x5678, arg 0xf161) ran 8 us after its return with marker B; no continue, no reset. 0x02: the signal handler ran once with marker B already in 0x55 on entry; with a 5 ms handler the finish handler ran only after it returned (5018 us, 5026 us); no continue, no reset. 0x03 with END 2: the signal handler ran once at the FINISH with list state 4, the FINISH did not call the finish handler, the list read paused for 98 polls, sceGeContinue returned 0, and the list then ran on to the bad-return marker at word 24 and the FINISH at word 25. With the NULL-handler id no handler ran; 0x01 and 0x02 completed and 0x03 paused until sceGeContinue (0). 0x00 and 0x04: no handler ran, marker B never ran, the list read 2 for 200 polls, sceGeContinue returned 0x80000020 and the probe's sceGeBreak(1) reset (0) was needed. RJUMP 0x20: no signal handler call, word 14 ran (finish handler 0x55), word 7 did not; words 12 and 13 not shown. RCALL 0x20: no signal handler call, word 14 ran and the RET returned to word 7. The third handler argument is consistent with the address of the word after the END that follows the SIGNAL or FINISH. A completed list read 0 for 0 to 9 polls and then 0x80000100.
tests.invariant: per cell, in fixed order: the signal and finish handler calls (count, arguments, list state, marker and time at the call), the run-length encoded list states of a bounded 100 ms poll, and, when the list still reads queued, drawing, stalled or paused, a deadline-bounded sceGeContinue and a second poll, then a sceGeBreak(1) reset only if the list still reads 1-4 or the GE is busy after a 100 ms bounded idle wait (never one sceGeDrawSync sample: the VSH draws its own lists in the XMB context); the marker commands are restored and both callback ids unregistered at teardown
tests.risk: medium; installs GE signal and finish handlers (removed at teardown) and runs project-written lists in probe RAM; the undefined behaviours 0x00 and 0x04 are expected to leave the GE stopped until the bounded sceGeBreak(1) reset, and the unaligned jump cells run last; POWER RISK: on 2026-11-10 rjump-un stalled the console until a manual power cycle, so rjump-un and rcall-un are not to be re-run unattended

Three forms, each loaded and started fresh: (0, 0, NULL), (1, 0, NULL) and (0, 4, an argp past the 64 MB of RAM, run last). All three behaved the same: the call did not return to its caller and the module was unloaded. The helper's entered marker was set, its call-return word and continued marker stayed at their preset sentinel, its module_stop ran exactly once, and sceKernelGetModuleIdByAddress on the helper's code afterwards answered 0x8002012e (the module is gone). Because that answer was below zero, the probe did not call sceKernelStopModule or sceKernelUnloadModule; the three -cleanup records hold only their preset sentinels. module_stop saw argument size 0 and argp 0 for the first two forms; for the third it saw size 4 and an argp that was not the caller's out-of-RAM pointer, and the call was neither refused nor faulted. Not tested: a call from the module_start thread, and a nonzero module_stop return. The raw stream and the decoded tables stay in the private campaign directory.
tests.invariant: #341: the return value, whether module_stop ran, whether the calling thread continued, and sceKernelGetModuleIdByAddress for an address inside the helper afterwards, for each of three argument forms.
tests.risk: medium; a successful self-unload ends the helper's thread and may fault the launch; the argp-past-RAM form runs last, each form has a durable step before it
tests.reset: one PRX launch with the helper PRX beside it on host0; a fresh boot before the next launch

tests.measurement_note: Measured by the 2026-11-08 PSP-3000 launch (system software 6.6.0 as reported by pspver; boot 156, XMB context) of commit 59520eb0, case hle-io-seek: 30 records, all PASS, harness verdict ok, acceptance-eligible. On a flash0 file (read-only) every refused seek leaves the position unchanged: the 64-bit sceIoLseek of SET -1, SET size+16, END +16 and END -(size+1) returns 0x80010016 in the low word and 0xffffffff in the high word, SET 0x100000000 and SET 0xFFFFFFFF return low 0x80010016 with high word 0, and the 32-bit sceIoLseek32 of the same offsets returns 0x80010016. Every sceIoIoctl file command (seek 0x01010005 to -1, 8, 16 and 32; queries 0x01020004, 0x01020003, 0x01020006, 0x01020007 and 0x01030008) on a probe-owned Memory Stick file returns 0x80020325 and changes nothing. On a disc0 file the ioctl seek to -1 returns 0x80010005, to the file size returns 0 and to size+1 returns 0x80010005, so it is range-checked at the size inclusive; the position ioctl returns 0 and writes only the low out word. sceIoWrite on a PSP_O_RDONLY descriptor returns 0x80020323 and leaves the file unchanged; PSP_O_RDONLY|PSP_O_CREAT on a missing file fails the open with 0x80010016 and creates nothing. The probe removed its own directory; no flash0 or disc0 byte was recorded. The raw stream and the decoded tables stay in the private campaign directory.
tests.invariant: Each seek, ioctl and read-only-descriptor write has a fixed-shape record of return values and 64-bit positions as (low, high) words; no file byte of flash0: or disc0: is recorded and the only writes are to a probe-owned ms0: directory the probe removes.
tests.risk: low; read-only on flash0: and disc0:, probe-owned ms0: directory only; the disc0: ioctl cells run last
tests.reset: one PRX launch; PSPLink soft reset before the next launch

tests.measurement_note: Measured by the 2026-11-11 PSP-3000 launch (system software 6.61, pspver 0x06060010 recorded as 6.6.0; custom firmware ARK-5 5.2.0 with cIPL, operator-declared; PSPLink built from pspdev/psplinkusb 7a0035d9; boot 192, XMB context, one launch on its own boot after the transport-write preflight) of commit 1a5157e37, case hle-io-seek-edges: 23 records and the done record, all PASS, COMPLETE PASS, acceptance-eligible with 0 blockers. On flash0:/font/ltn0.pgf opened PSP_O_RDONLY, from a position of 8, all 14 out-of-range seeks return 0x80010016 and leave the position at 8 (64-bit SEEK_CUR -9, to size+16, to 0xFFFFFFFF and to 0x100000000; sceIoLseek32 SEEK_CUR -9 and to size+16; 64-bit SEEK_SET 0x100000001, 0x200000000, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000 and 0xFFFFFFFE; SEEK_END to 0xFFFFFFFF and to 0x100000000); SEEK_SET 0x10000 succeeds. The high word of a refused 64-bit seek is 0xffffffff for SEEK_CUR -9, SEEK_CUR to size+16 and SEEK_SET 0x7FFFFFFF, and 0 for the nine targets at or above 0x80000000. On a probe-owned Memory Stick file: PSP_O_RDONLY|PSP_O_CREAT on an existing file opens it, a 4-byte sceIoWrite returns 0x80020323 and the file is unchanged; PSP_O_RDONLY|PSP_O_CREAT|PSP_O_TRUNC on it is refused with 0x80010016 and the file keeps its 16 bytes; PSP_O_RDONLY|PSP_O_CREAT|PSP_O_EXCL on a missing name is refused with 0x80010016 and creates nothing; sceIoWriteAsync of 4 bytes on a PSP_O_RDONLY descriptor returns 0x80020323 at once and queues nothing. The probe removed its own ms0:/NKIOSK02; no flash0 byte was recorded. The raw stream stays in the private campaign directory.
tests.invariant: Each seek, open-flag and read-only-descriptor write has a fixed-shape record of return values, counts and 64-bit positions or results as (low, high) words; no file byte of flash0: is recorded, no disc0: call is made, every async wait is bounded, and the only writes are to a probe-owned ms0: directory the probe removes.
tests.risk: low; read-only on flash0:, writes only the probe-owned ms0:/NKIOSK02 it creates when absent and removes; every async wait bounded
tests.reset: one PRX launch; PSPLink soft reset before the next launch
